user: Will the dispute cover the full charge?
answer:
The knowledge base doesn't say whether a duplicate_charge dispute can be partial. The dispute tool defaults to the full transaction amount, so if I open it without specifying an amount, it will cover the full **EUR 240.00** on TX-0401.

The knowledge base also says:
- A **provisional credit** may be applied while the dispute is reviewed. It is reversed if the dispute is declined.
- You can **withdraw** a dispute before it is resolved, but withdrawal is final, and the same transaction can't be disputed again under the same reason code.

The eligibility deadline is 2026-09-18. If you confirm that TX-0401 duplicates TX-0402 and want the full amount disputed, reply to confirm and I'll open it for EUR 240.00. If you want a partial amount or have questions about the review process, tell me, and I can escalate to a human agent.

Currency conversion guide
## Reading a quote
A complete quote lists: mid rate, spread percentage applied, allowance total
and allowance used before this conversion, gross converted amount, spread
amount, and the final credited amount. The final amount equals the gross
amount minus the spread amount.

Glossary
## Provisional credit
A temporary refund applied while a dispute is reviewed; reversed if the dispute
is declined.

Complaints
## Difference from a dispute
A dispute concerns a specific transaction. A complaint concerns the service
itself: a delay, an error, or the conduct of an agent. The two follow separate
processes.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.
